title: skydipole: a monopole-aware dipole estimator for binary-labelled sky catalogues (code, data and results)

creators.name: Medeni, İhsan Tolga
creators.affiliation: Ankara Yıldırım Beyazıt University, Ankara, Turkey

description: Python package that fits a monopole and a dipole jointly (OLS, full normal matrix) to a binary-labelled catalogue on a partial sky footprint, calibrates the free-axis test by vectorised label permutation, reports fixed-axis projections and injection-recovery sensitivity. Includes the Galaxy Zoo 1 handedness label file (derived from VizieR J/MNRAS/410/166), all example-application scripts, reference outputs, a test suite and the timing benchmark.
